invariants.description: High pressure trip: When process pressure reaches HIGH alarm setpoint, an alarm shall be generated. When it reaches HIGH-HIGH trip setpoint, equipment shall be stopped.

z3_template.invariant_assertion: (and (=> (>= pressure p_high) alarm_active) (=> (>= pressure p_high_high) (not equipment_running)))
z3_template.omission_check: Missing HIGH alarm or HIGH-HIGH trip for pressure on {equipment}

invariants.description: Low pressure trip: When suction pressure drops to LOW-LOW, pump shall stop to prevent cavitation and mechanical damage.

z3_template.invariant_assertion: (and (=> (<= pressure p_low) alarm_active) (=> (<= pressure p_low_low) (not pump_running)))
z3_template.omission_check: Missing LOW alarm or LOW-LOW trip for pump suction pressure on {equipment}

invariants.description: Pressure relief valve must be present for any vessel operating above atmospheric pressure. Its setpoint must be documented.

z3_template.omission_check: No pressure relief valve or setpoint documented for vessel {equipment}
